title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
symptoms: ERROR: remaining connection slots are reserved
diagnosis: Check pgbouncer stats: SHOW POOLS; Look for high wait_count. Verify application connection lifecycle. Check for connection leaks in long-running transactions.
resolution:
1. Restart pgbouncer: systemctl restart pgbouncer
2. Increase pool_size in pgbouncer.ini if needed
3. Fix application connection leaks
4. Set statement_timeout = '30s' and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '60s'
prevention: Implement connection health checks. Use connection pooling libraries correctly. Monitor pool saturation alerts.
author: platform-team

title: Kubernetes Pod OOMKilled
diagnosis: kubectl describe pod <pod-name> - check Last State. Check memory limits vs requests. Profile application memory usage. Look for memory leaks.
resolution:
1. Increase memory limit: resources.limits.memory
2. Set GOMEMLIMIT or -Xmx appropriately
3. Enable memory profiling
4. Add memory request to guarantee QoS
prevention: Set memory requests = limits for Guaranteed QoS. Implement memory profiling in CI. Alert on memory usage > 80% limit.
author: platform-team

title: Redis Cache Stampede
symptoms: Sudden latency spike on cache miss
Cache hit rate drops to near zero
diagnosis: Check Redis INFO stats for keyspace misses. Look for hot keys expiring simultaneously. Monitor DB connection count.
resolution:
1. Implement distributed lock (Redis SETNX) for cache rebuild
2. Use probabilistic early expiration (jitter TTL)
3. Add request coalescing
4. Pre-warm cache on deployment
prevention: Use cache-aside with lock pattern. Stagger TTL with random jitter. Monitor cache hit rate alerts.
author: platform-team

title: Kafka Consumer Lag Spike
diagnosis: Check consumer group lag per partition. Look for slow processing. Check for poison pills. Verify partition assignment strategy.
resolution:
1. Scale consumer instances
2. Increase fetch.min.bytes and fetch.max.wait.ms
3. Handle poison pills with DLQ
4. Use cooperative sticky assignor
prevention: Monitor lag per partition. Set max.poll.interval.ms appropriately. Implement dead letter queues.
author: data-team

title: Certificate Expiration - TLS
symptoms: API clients fail with SSL errors
diagnosis: kubectl get certificates -A. Check cert-manager logs. Verify ACME challenge completion. Check DNS propagation for HTTP-01.
resolution:
1. Force renewal: kubectl delete certificate <name>
2. Check cert-manager pod logs
3. Verify DNS records for domain validation
4. Check rate limits with Let's Encrypt
prevention: Monitor certificate expiry alerts (30/14/7 days). Use multiple issuers. Test renewal in staging.
author: security-team

title: CI/CD Pipeline Stuck - GitHub Actions
diagnosis: Check GitHub Actions runner status. Verify self-hosted runner connectivity. Check for runner version mismatch. Look at workflow concurrency limits.
resolution:
1. Restart self-hosted runners
2. Check runner logs: journalctl -u actions.runner.*
3. Verify network connectivity to GitHub
4. Scale runner pool if consistently busy
prevention: Monitor runner queue depth. Auto-scale runner pools. Health check runners every 5 min.
author: platform-team

title: S3 Cross-Region Replication Lag
diagnosis: Check S3 Replication metrics in CloudWatch. Verify IAM roles for replication. Check for object size limits. Verify bucket versioning enabled.
resolution:
1. Verify source/destination bucket policies
2. Check replication configuration rules
3. Replicate failed objects manually
4. Contact AWS support if systemic
prevention: Monitor replication lag alerts. Test DR failover quarterly. Verify compliance reports.
author: data-team

title: Database Migration Failed - Lock Timeout
symptoms: ERROR: canceling statement due to lock timeout
diagnosis: Check pg_stat_activity for blocking queries. Long-running transactions holding locks. Missing CONCURRENTLY on index creation. Heavy read/write during migration.
resolution:
1. Kill blocking queries: pg_terminate_backend(pid)
2. Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
3. Split large ALTER TABLE into steps
4. Run migrations during low traffic
prevention: Test migrations on staging with production data volume. Use pg_lock_timeout. Implement zero-downtime migration patterns.
author: platform-team
